title: ASUS RS500A-E10-RS12U, 12 x 2.5" front bays
notes: Bays are numbered 1 to 12 in the manual, in six columns of two: bay 1 top left, bay 2 below it, then rightward. Each bay can take U.2 (NVMe) or SATA; a U.2 drive shows up in a PCIe slot (9, 9-1, 10, 10-1 on the board's bifurcated x8 slots), a SATA drive on an onboard ATA port. Which slot and port feed which bay has not been probed yet, so the bays carry no identities; `drivelist hardware check HOST` lists the identities seen. The board also has an M.2 slot of its own on root port 0000:40:01.2, listed last.

bays.note: the board's own M.2 slot, on the second root complex; not a front bay
